# CSBHI — Conformal Scaling of Black Hole Interiors

> CSBHI is a developing research programme investigating whether the reciprocal ansatz a(tau) = 1/r(tau) relates black-hole infall to cosmological expansion. The primary paper states the proposal and its observable consequences; the accompanying notes distinguish established calculations, conditional results, conjectures, and open problems.

The public site is statically hosted. Core papers contain their substantive text directly in HTML; the project overview and review packet compose some sections from static data-wrapper views. Research notes are also available as raw Markdown at the URLs below, so no JavaScript execution is required to read them. Equations use LaTeX notation.

## AI collaborator onboarding and debugging

If you are an AI system reviewing, explaining, or extending CSBHI, read [AI Collaborator Onboarding and Review Protocol](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/ai_collaborator_onboarding.md) before beginning substantive work.

Use that guide to:

- distinguish correspondences, conditional theorems, predictions, and open problems;
- avoid replacing Alice's reciprocal interior with a standard vacuum Schwarzschild interior;
- distinguish the project's different radii and horizons;
- classify an apparent failure as an error, circular argument, model substitution, incomplete derivation, observational conflict, or contradiction; and
- resolve conflicts between archived calculations and the canonical review packet.

When debugging your interpretation, use the guide's claim ledger and interpretation guardrails. The guide is machine-facing operational context, not a research result and not a request to agree with the theory.

## Primary papers

- [Geometric Duality: Conformal Scaling of Black Hole Interiors](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/gd1.html): The principal CSBHI preprint by Gilan Salehi. Introduces the reciprocal ansatz, relates inward flow to expansion, discusses singularity deferral, and compares the construction with cosmological observables.

## Reciprocal Interior technical papers

- [RI I — Field Equations of the Reciprocal Interior](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/field_equations_of_the_reciprocal_interior.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives the reciprocal-interior dynamics from the metric ansatz, Einstein's equations, and stress-energy conservation.
- [RI II — Junction Conditions for the Reciprocal Interior](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/junctions.html), by Codex (OpenAI): Early synthesis draft testing timelike, null, thermodynamic, and dynamical junction conditions and isolating the requirements for a complete throat geometry.

## Main results and predictions

- [The Evolving Galactic Acceleration-Scale Correspondence](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/evolving_g_dagger_derivation.md), by Claude (Anthropic): The reciprocal ansatz applied to galaxies. A symmetry theorem fixes the square-root mixing law; identifying the global scale with the contemporaneous cosmological horizon gives the coefficient-free, falsifiable prediction g†(z)/g†(0)=H(z)/H0 — rising where MOND is flat, and favored by the first intermediate-redshift data. The programme's one live empirical prediction.
- [The Reciprocal Ansatz as the Unique Scale-Free Horizon-Fixing Involution](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/reciprocal-involution.html), by Claude (Anthropic): Proves a=1/r is the unique nontrivial scale-free, horizon-fixing involution — the reciprocal map is forced, not chosen.
- [The Weyl Curvature Hypothesis as a Fixed Point](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/recursive_bhc_and_the_weyl_curvature_hypothesis.md), by Claude (Anthropic): The low-Weyl beginning as a consequence of formation — smooth collapse gives a Weyl-free child, so Penrose's condition is a fixed point of the succession rather than a fine-tuning, and the entropy arrow follows without information loss.
- [A Black Hole on the Aeon Boundary](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/shear_free_interior_weyl_stress_identity.md), by Claude (Anthropic): The interior Weyl field dilutes at the conformal weight a^-2, so a black hole can sit on the aeon boundary as a regular, seed-carrying crossover without needing to evaporate.

## Prerequisite graph

Only immediate prerequisites are listed; follow the chain back to GD1 as needed.

- GD1: start here.
- RI I, Field Equations of the Reciprocal Interior: GD1.
- Result I, The Reciprocal Ansatz as the Unique Scale-Free Horizon-Fixing Involution: GD1.
- Prediction I, The Evolving Galactic Acceleration-Scale Correspondence: Result I.
- Result II, The Weyl Curvature Hypothesis as a Fixed Point: GD1.
- A Black Hole on the Aeon Boundary (the regular crossover): GD1.
- GD II outline, Cosmological Succession and the Horizon Map: Result II.
- GD III outline, Throat Curvature and the Galaxy Acceleration Law: Prediction I.
- Horizon Thermodynamics outline: GD III.
- RI II, Junction Conditions for the Reciprocal Interior: RI I.
- AI XVII, The Weyl Curvature Hypothesis at Background Order (companion to Result II): GD1.
- Note III, Self-Dual Homogeneous Derivation of the Square-Root Law (supports Prediction I): GD1.
- The Evolving Galactic Acceleration Scale and its High-Redshift Test (GD III preparation): Prediction I.
- Supporting calculations — independent verification, horizon-flow and shell identities, junction and optical results, and the cosmological clocks: RI I.
- The 5D de Sitter throat and its Painlevé–Gullstrand flow: GD1, retained only as the late-time vacuum-dominated limit.

## Project pages

- [CSBHI project overview](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/): Publication map, progress, open problems, and further reading.
- [Review Packet I](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/review.html): Guided professional-review packet separating the foundational ansatz, conditional results, theorem, correspondence, prediction, and open construction problems.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/faqs.html): Short answers to recurring conceptual and mathematical objections.
- [CSBHI Cosmological Glossary](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/cosmological_glossary.md): Shared symbol legend and plain-language reference for the physics, cosmology, horizons, distances, expansion, and junction geometry used across the project.
- [What Remains Mathematically Illegible](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/open_questions.md): Living index of the unresolved geometric, cosmological, empirical, and extension questions, ordered by dependency.
- [Alice's Descent](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/leap-of-faith.html): Interactive geometric illustration accompanying the primary paper.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/gilansalehi/csbhi): HTML source, research notes, figures, and revision history.

## Independently authored supporting calculations

- [The Reciprocal Interior: An Independent Verification](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/reciprocal_interior_independent_verification.md), by Claude (Anthropic): Independently calculates and audits the reciprocal-interior field equations.
- [The Horizon Flow and Density Identity](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/horizon_flow_density_identity.md), observed by Gemini and reviewed by Codex: Examines the horizon density identity and the geodesic boundary condition on which it depends.
- [The Exact Shell Identity and the Kottler Mass Condition for Alice's Interior](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/horizon_map_shell_identity_and_mass_growth.md), by Claude (Anthropic): Derives areal-radius continuity, the Kottler mass condition, and the radiation-pressure residual for a comoving timelike boundary.
- [Vacuum-Energy Cancellation at an FLRW-Kottler Junction](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/vacuum_energy_cancellation_at_a_kottler_junction.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Independently derives the corresponding timelike junction conditions and vacuum-energy cancellation.
- [Null Optics of the Reciprocal Interior](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/null_optics_of_the_reciprocal_interior.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives the interior optical transfer laws, isolates the missing radial event map, and tests the first null-junction condition.
- [Null-Horizon Matching of the Reciprocal Interior](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/null_horizon_matching_of_the_reciprocal_interior.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives the Schwarzschild-radius/apparent-horizon-radius identity from the first null junction condition and computes the transverse-curvature mismatch for direct Schwarzschild–de Sitter solderings.
- [Recursive Kottler Horizons and the Galaxy Acceleration Scale](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/recursive_kottler_horizons_and_the_galaxy_scale.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives a conditional parent–child cosmological-constant relation in the minimal recursive Kottler model and compares its horizon surface gravity with the empirical galaxy acceleration scale.
- [Dynamic Throat Kinematics and the Cosmological Clock](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/dynamic_throat_kinematics_and_the_cosmological_clock.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives the moving-null-boundary expansion identities, reconstructs the boundary history required by the observed cosmological epochs, and identifies present-day targets for a parent horizon-growth calculation.
- [Thermodynamic Accounting of the Transverse Junction](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/thermodynamic_accounting_of_the_transverse_junction.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Shows that the same-orientation stationary null-shell tension is the interior work density projected from volume to area, tracks how causal orientation redistributes the shell data, and derives the corresponding apparent-horizon target through the radiation, matter, and vacuum epochs.
- [The Nonequilibrium Event Horizon and the CMB Clock](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/nonequilibrium_event_horizon_and_the_cmb_clock.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Derives the nonequilibrium residual on the reconstructed event horizon and shows that the CMB fixes the radiation work and reciprocal scale-factor clock rather than the horizon temperature.
- [The Hyperbolic Cosmological Clock](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/hyperbolic_cosmological_clock.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Uses the asymptotic 5D de Sitter embedding to define a geometric boost clock, obtains the same present rapidity from age and density data, and separates that clock from the finite-throat contribution to absolute expansion.
- [The Evolving Galactic Acceleration Scale and its High-Redshift Test](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/evolving_acceleration_scale_high_z_test.md), by Claude (Anthropic): Develops the conditional redshift-dependent galaxy-scale prediction associated with the planned GD III dynamics.
- [The Weyl Curvature Hypothesis at Background Order](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/weyl_curvature_hypothesis_reciprocal_interior.md), by Codex (OpenAI): Explains how homogeneous parent collapse supplies the child's low-Weyl FLRW beginning at background order and identifies perturbation transfer as the remaining empirical test. The fixed-point synthesis is Result II.
- [The Reciprocal Ansatz as the Unique Scale-Free Horizon-Fixing Involution](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/reciprocal-involution.html), by Claude (Anthropic): Proves that a = 1/r is the unique non-trivial scale-free horizon-fixing involution, deriving the reciprocal power from a symmetry shared with the GD III galaxy law (closes Open Question Q1).

## Supporting derivations and planned notes

- [The Inverse-Radius Interior and Alice's Probe Congruence](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd_inverse_radius_probe_congruence.md): Develops the probe-cloud interpretation of inverse-radius spatial scaling.
- [Painleve-Gullstrand Flow from the 5D de Sitter Embedding](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/pg_flow_from_5d_desitter_embedding.md): The 5D de Sitter embedding and its PG flow, exact in the late-time vacuum-dominated limit only — a curio describing the child's asymptotic future, not the full throat geometry (which is GD II's horizon map).

## Context and research programme

- [Black-Hole Cosmology: Lineage, Mechanisms, and CSBHI](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/black_hole_cosmology_lineage.md): Historical comparison with earlier black-hole cosmology proposals.
- [Geometric Duality Research Roadmap](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd_research_roadmap.md): Current sequence of questions, notation, and planned investigations. The roadmap is provisional.
- [GD Self-Dual Homogeneous Derivation of the Square-Root Law](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd_self_dual_homogeneous_derivation_of_the_square_root_law.md): Conditional functional-equation derivation relevant to a proposed galaxy-scale law.

## Planning outlines

- [Geometric Duality II: Cosmological Succession and the Horizon Map](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd2_collapse_cohort_horizon_map_outline.md): Working outline for the primary-author construction paper — the collapse-cohort horizon map carrying a black-hole interior into the successor aeon. (An earlier "5D de Sitter throat" outline is retained as a curio describing only the late-time limit.)
- [Geometric Duality III: Throat Curvature and the Galaxy Acceleration Law](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd3_throat_curvature_and_galaxy_law_outline.md): Working outline, not a completed result.
- [Horizon Thermodynamics and the GD Interpretation](https://www.gilansalehi.com/csbhi/notes/gd_thermodynamic_reconciliation_outline.md): Working outline for thermodynamic consistency questions.

## Reading guidance

Begin with GD1, then follow the main path: RI I (the interior is a real matter–radiation–Λ cosmology), Result I (the reciprocal map is the unique scale-free horizon-fixing involution), Prediction I (the evolving g† galaxy-acceleration prediction), and Result II (the Weyl Curvature Hypothesis as a fixed point, with the regular crossover on the aeon boundary). The forthcoming primary-author papers are GD II (cosmological succession and the horizon map) and GD III (the galaxy acceleration law). The remaining notes are supporting calculations, audits, and active-frontier working drafts that will be consolidated over time. The 5D de Sitter throat is retained only as the late-time vacuum-dominated limit, not the full cosmology. Treat documents labeled as hypotheses, outlines, or drafts as work under active review rather than established conclusions.
